title: fix(metadata-protocol,spec)!: the bare item read refuses a package-less row beside two row holders, and reads a row-held base at its dependent's added member (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_
Fixes #33210

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (the ADR-0146 paragraph) and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` teach that a locale a dependent adds under a base's name is served only under its own `?package=`, and that the read naming no package answers `404` for it. Both sentences were true only for a base that ships the name, and are now true for a row-held base too, at a dependent's named locale other than the canonical one, however many dependents each add one. Nothing in `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches what the read naming no package answers for a package-less row beside two packages' rows.

> **BREAKING**: two answers of the `/meta` item read that names no package move from served to refused (table below). Name the package (`?package=`) to read the row, as before. ADR-0087: `registered row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base, two-row-holders-bare-read-refused`.

**Clause-② arm.** `no (narrowing)`, as contract review record 6915442261 ② confirmed: nothing moves from refused to served.

**Round 2 (contract review record 6915442261, VERDICT FAIL at b959edb979; delta record 6922561329, PASS at 2b9293e63a with S2 and N3 open).** M1, S1, N1 and N2 are addressed below and closed by 6922561329. S2 is fixed at 5e2b66314c (below). N3 is this body. The earlier body called `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` "area-approved" and the new spec entry "seat-approved". No record of either approval is on #33210 or this thread, so both attributions are withdrawn. Both files are declared here as extensions of the claim's file surface: one call site in the layered read, and the ADR-0087 entry the (c) move needs.

**Round 3 (L1-b 6925025713, REWORK R1 to R3; delta record 6931462446, PASS at 45427375 with S3, N5 and N6 open).** R1 and R2 (body half) are this body; R3 is `6f4fdf19` (the RestServer `[#33210]` refusals pinned by `[status, code]`). S3 and N5 are `891338265`: the changeset's last "Not moved" sentence said the package-less save beside two holders still edits the row; measured on the bare-save harness, that save is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming E and F and writes nothing, before and after this change, so the note now says so and cites #34348 only for its own shape. The S2 pin now reads the shared member `?member=en-US`. N6 is this body. `origin/main` merged at `3bbce494e` (merge only, no conflict).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:不带 `?package=` 的元数据按名读取有两处改为拒绝/404。(a) 同名项只有两个包的存储行加一条无包行、且没有包在代码中发布时,普通读取、`/published` 与执行读取一律 409 点名两个包(与 `/layers` 一致),不再按保存顺序挑一行;(c) 基础包只以存储行持有某名、依赖包在另一非规范成员(如 `fr-FR`)加了一行时,不带包的读取在该成员上答 404,与基础包在代码中发布时一致;多个依赖包各加一个成员时同样成立。
- 为什么改:ADR-0150 红线 2(歧义只报告、不猜),卡片 #33210 的 (a)(c) 两项;(d) 修正 ADR-0087 条目 `two-row-holders-bare-read-refused` 的 `reason` 文字。第二轮按合同复审 6915442261 修 M1(两个依赖包时第一轮仍按 200 返回)与 S1(规范成员镜像不再被挪动),并按 6922561329 修 S2(依赖包同时存了基础包的成员时,按注册表规则仍算追加)。
- 风险与回滚:收窄:上述两种形态的裸读从 200 变为 409/404;精确地址 `?package=` 不变,写入不变,不点名成员的读取(规范成员与 `/published`)不变。首方应用无此形态(计数 0)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 的 `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`(每个包按自己的依赖闭包判定是否为追加;只对点名的非规范成员生效),以及 `servedRowHolderOf` / `storedRowHoldersRefusal` 的无包行分支。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts -t "M1 two dependents|S1|S2"`,预期 10 个用例全部通过(两个依赖包 4 个、共享成员 4 个、规范成员镜像 2 个)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(需一次覆盖 spec 面的 L2 合同复审,针对本轮新 head)。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`
  - (a) `storedRowHoldersRefusal` (the no-disabled arm of the item face's served-holder judgment) refuses naming the holders when a package-less row sits beside two or more of them, as `/layers` does. Beside one holder or none, the package-less row still leaves the read as it was (CONTROL).
  - (a) `servedRowHolderOf` reads the rows before honouring the registry's environment item on the item face. After a reboot that item is the bare slot's entry, the row hydrated last, so it was the package-less row whenever that row was saved last. With rows bound to two or more packages beside it, it is judged with them. Beside a disabled holder the read is left as it was. (N2) Its docblock now says so.
  - (c) `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`. The read naming no package, at a named non-canonical bundle member that only dependents' additions hold over a base holding the name only as stored rows, takes the base's address, as it does when the base ships the name. (M1) Each row-holding package is judged against its own declared dependency closure, as the registry's `isBundleAddition` judges it. A package is an addition when some other row holder is in its closure and it is not in that holder's. The base is the one row holder that is no addition. So a second dependent (D1 `fr-FR`, D2 `de-DE` over A's `en-US`) leaves A the base at both members, in either registration order. At b959edb979 the rule was "exactly one row holder without a row at the member", which found A and D2 at `fr-FR` and served D1's row. (S1) The arm moves only a named member other than the canonical one; the canonical-member mirror is left as it was (below). (S2) No member clashes on this arm: the registry counts a clash only at a member shipped in code (`codeMembersOf`), and the arm runs only for a name no package ships. So a dependent that also stores a member the base stores (D's `en-US` and `fr-FR` over A's `en-US`) stays an addition. At 2b9293e63a any shared member was a clash, which gave two bases and served D's `fr-FR` (200).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`: one call to `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` beside `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf`, so `/layers` agrees with the plain read.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.two-row-holders-bare-read-refused.ts` (d): only the `reason` text changes.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base.ts`: the ADR-0087 semantic entry for (c). Round 2: the `surface` and `acceptanceCriteria` say "named member other than the canonical one" and "one or more dependents", and the surface says the read naming no member and `/published` do not move. (N1) The `reason` no longer attributes "a bundle addition holds no name" to ADR-0150 D3; the header comment cites the rule's source (the `packageScopedHoldersOf` docblock, epic child R2).
- `.changeset/33210-packageless-row-two-holders.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec`. Its second bullet and `Skills-docs:` sentence now say what the code does (M1, S1).

### FROM → TO (every moved answer)

| Shape | Door (naming no package) | FROM (`main`) | TO |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| (a) E's row + F's row + a package-less row, no shipper | plain read, `/published`, execution read | 200, the row stored first (package-less, E's or F's, by save order) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details.candidates` = E, F |
| (a) same | `/layers` | 409 naming E, F | unchanged |
| (a) same, package-less row saved last, after a reboot | plain read | 200, E's row | 409 naming E, F |
| (c) base A's `en-US` row, dependent D's `fr-FR` row, no shipper | plain read, `/layers`, execution read at `?member=fr-FR` | 200, D's row | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| (c) same with a second dependent D2's `de-DE` row (M1) | same, at `fr-FR` and at `de-DE` | 200, each dependent's row | 404 |
| (c) D also stores `en-US` beside its `fr-FR` (S2) | same, at `fr-FR` | 200, D's row | 404 |
| (c) A ships `en-US` (CONTROL) | same | 404 | unchanged |
| CONTROL: E's row + a package-less row | every bare door | 200, E's row | unchanged |
| CONTROL (S1): A's `fr-FR` row, D's canonical `en-US` row | the read naming no member, `?member=en-US`, `/published`, `/layers`, execution read | 200, D's row | unchanged |
| any | `?package=E` / `?package=F` / `?package=D&member=fr-FR` | own row | unchanged |

**S1, which option and why.** The arm is guarded to a named non-canonical member rather than pinned beside a shipped CONTROL. Measured on a booted kernel: with A shipping only `fr-FR` and D storing the canonical `en-US`, the read naming no member serves A's `fr-FR`, and `/published` and `/layers` move across a reboot (200 D's row, then 404). There is no single shipped answer to align the row-held cell with. Unguarded (b959edb979), the row-held cell answered 404 before a reboot and A's `fr-FR` after it. Guarded, it serves D's row on every door in both save orders, before and after a reboot, as on `main`. The shipped cell's own movement is reported to the seat as a separate finding, not fixed here.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`: describe `[#33210]`, all 6 save orders of the three rows on every door plus each exact address, and a one-holder CONTROL in both save orders.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`:
  - (a) Three save orders × two registration orders, before and after a reboot, plus the CONTROL.
  - (c) M2: the row-held base in both save orders, and the shipped base as CONTROL, before and after a reboot.
  - (c) M1, new: two dependents (D1 `fr-FR`, D2 `de-DE`) registered and saved A, D1, D2 and D2, D1, A, row-held and shipped (CONTROL), before and after a reboot. Each member answers 404 on the plain read, `/layers` and the execution read, and is served at its own address. The base's `en-US` stays the base's.
  - S2, new: D storing `en-US` and `fr-FR` over A's `en-US`, registered and saved A, D and D, A, row-held and shipped (CONTROL), before and after a reboot. `fr-FR` answers 404 on the plain read, `/layers` and the execution read, and `?package=D` serves it. (N5) The shared member `?member=en-US` naming no package is not moved: the shipped base serves its own row (200), and over a row-held base A's and D's rows of it are refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both.
  - S1, new: the canonical-member mirror in both save orders, before and after a reboot. Every door naming no package serves D's row, and the base's `fr-FR` stays the base's (CONTROL).

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, carried by #34440: a package-less row beside a disabled holder and served holders. The plain read follows save order, `/published` serves the package-less row, and `/layers` refuses naming the disabled package. This was measured, and the disabled arm is unchanged from `main`.
- Out of scope, carried by #34441: with a shipped base holding only a non-canonical member and a dependent's canonical row, the read naming no member serves the base's other member, and `/published` and `/layers` move across a reboot.
- Writes, not moved: in shape (a) the save naming no package is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming E and F and writes nothing, on both transports and in both save orders, measured before this change (where the plain read served a row by save order) and after it (where the read refuses as well). A save that edits a package-unbound row while the read refuses is another shape, two enabled packages that ship the name with no package's row stored, and is #34348 (decision open).
- Out of scope, carried by #34441 (folded there as its second cell, 6933869894): in the S2 shape the shared canonical member `?member=en-US` answers differently by how the base holds the name: a shipped base's row (200), or over a row-held base `409` naming A and D. This change does not move it (measured before it, before a reboot, on the same harness).

## Verification
